Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class RenderGalleryChecks

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.RenderGalleryChecks
public final class RenderGalleryChecks extends Object
The render-gallery world builder: that a queued gallery lays out its floor and rows as described and reports the totals it finished with, spread across ticks by the configured placement limit.

  • Method Details

    • commandsEnforcePolicyAndGalleryPermissions

      public static void commandsEnforcePolicyAndGalleryPermissions(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
      To reproduce: as a nonoperator, try /ss deny item add minecraft:stone and both gallery commands; none may execute. As an operator, try galleries with enabled=false, then with enabled=true and required_permission_level=3 at levels 2 and 3. Only the level-3 player may start construction; a console source may not. At level 2, add/remove stone from the deny-item list and confirm player deposits are refused/allowed respectively; an unknown item must not alter policy. Use a clear gallery site and restore the original settings after checking.

      The fixture executes a registered dispatcher, uses copied command sources rather than changing operator records, and intercepts policy saves. The Bar gallery covers the minecraft ingots, which fit one Bar Stack. Accepted jobs are drained through the generator's tick entry point in this scenario; asynchronous construction is covered separately by the queued-gallery test.

    • galleryItemsAreInIdOrderWithoutDeniedItems

      public static void galleryItemsAreInIdOrderWithoutDeniedItems(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce: enable galleries, run /ss deny item add minecraft:stone, then /ss gallery minecraft on a clear site. The items read in id order and stone does not appear. Restore the deny list afterward.

    • queuedStorageGalleryBuildsFloorRowsAndCompletionTotals

      public static void queuedStorageGalleryBuildsFloorRowsAndCompletionTotals(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
      Internal gallery plan: enqueue ten ordinary items as one group and iron ingot as another; after 60 ticks assert three Storage blocks, eleven total items, and smooth-sandstone flooring east of the player, with rows extending north. Exact grouping and completion-callback values have no direct command reproduction.

      Nearest manual check: enable render_gallery.enabled and use a player with the configured gallery permission. Set gen_items with /ss gen item add, then run /ss gallery items on a clear site. Watch construction proceed across ticks according to placements_per_tick and inspect the eastward floor and northward rows.
